# The Open Psychology Journal

> > An open access peer-reviewed psychology journal publishing original research, reviews, and letters under Creative Commons licensing through Bentham Science Publishers.

The Open Psychology Journal is a peer-reviewed open access publication indexed in Scopus that adheres to COPE guidelines for research ethics and integrity. The journal operates under CC-BY 4.0 licensing, allowing free access and reuse of published research while maintaining rigorous editorial standards.

## Key Topics

- Open Access Publishing
- Peer Review
- Psychology Research
- Publication Ethics
- Research Misconduct

## Journal Overview

- [Home Page](https://openpsychologyjournal.com): Open Access psychology journal homepage featuring articles, reviews, and research publications.
- [About the Journal](https://openpsychologyjournal.com/about-the-journal.php): Journal overview covering peer-review, indexing, article processing, and submission details.
- [About The Publisher](https://openpsychologyjournal.com/about-the-publisher.php): Bentham Science Publishers information, CC-BY 4.0 licensing, and open access publishing model.

## Manuscript Submission & Guidelines

- [Submit Papers](https://openpsychologyjournal.com/call-for-papers.php): Manuscript submission guidelines, thematic issues, and peer review process information.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://openpsychologyjournal.com/frequently-asked-questions.php): FAQ covering manuscript submission, peer review, publication process, and copyright policies.
- [Open Access Policy](https://openpsychologyjournal.com/open-access-policy.php): Open access policy details including CC-BY 4.0 licensing, APCs, and copyright retention.
- [Editorial Policies](https://openpsychologyjournal.com/editorial-policies.php): Comprehensive editorial policies covering peer review, COI, preprints, and CC-BY 4.0 licensing.

## Editorial Leadership & Management

- [Editorial Board](https://openpsychologyjournal.com/editorial-board.php): Editorial board leadership including Editor-in-Chief Roberto Truzoli and governance structure.
- [Editorial Management](https://openpsychologyjournal.com/editorial-management.php): Editorial board structure, editor roles, and publication governance framework.
- [Guest Topical Issue Editor(s)](https://openpsychologyjournal.com/guest-topical-issue-editor.php): Guest editor information and topical issue coordination for special journal editions.

## Research Ethics & Integrity

- [Publishing Ethics and Rectitude](https://openpsychologyjournal.com/publishing-ethics.php): Editorial standards, peer review integrity, and misconduct prevention policies.
- [Research Misconduct](https://openpsychologyjournal.com/research-misconduct.php): Research misconduct types, complaint procedures, and COPE guideline compliance framework.
- [Plagiarism Prevention](https://openpsychologyjournal.com/plagiarism-prevention.php): Plagiarism detection using iThenticate, citation guidelines, and academic integrity standards.
- [Conflict of Interest](https://openpsychologyjournal.com/conflict-of-interest.php): Author disclosure requirements for financial and institutional conflicts of interest.
- [Fabricating and Stating False Information](https://openpsychologyjournal.com/fabricating-and-stating-false-information.php): Publication ethics policy addressing fabrication, corrections, and retraction procedures.

## Post-Publication & Content Standards

- [Post Publication Discussions and Corrections](https://openpsychologyjournal.com/post-publication-discussions-and-corrections.php): Post-publication corrections, retractions, and editorial expressions of concern procedures.
- [Ensuring Content Integrity](https://openpsychologyjournal.com/ensuring-content-integrity.php): Content integrity assurance via CrossMark, CrossRef, and Scopus indexing standards.
- [Allegations From Whistleblowers](https://openpsychologyjournal.com/allegations-from-whistleblowers.php): Ethics Advisory Panel response to whistleblower allegations and COPE guideline compliance.

## Optional & Technical Reference

- [Open URL Guidelines](https://openpsychologyjournal.com/open-url-guidelines.php): Technical documentation for DOI linking, URL syntax, and article access guidelines.
